decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication builds directly on the firm's metalworking-fluid and coolant expertise, so it can read early market feedback and refine the system with its existing knowledge base, even though the website gives no evidence after 2019.
A hydrocyclone coolant filter is closely related to the firm's core coolant filtration competence, which gives it high absorptive capacity to assimilate customer results and improve the product.
Gravity band filters are a mature, well-understood filtration technology that fits the firm's established knowledge and its machine-tool customer base, so keeping the product carries little risk.
